sentences.englishText: A bad accident occurred in the English Channel involving an oil tanker and a cargo ship.
sentences.turkishText: İngiliz Kanalı'nda bir petrol tankeri ve bir kargo gemisinin karıştığı kötü bir kaza meydana geldi.

sentences.englishText: The accident happened in the morning and the weather conditions were very stormy at the time.
sentences.turkishText: Kaza sabah oldu ve o sırada hava koşulları çok fırtınalıydı.

enrichment.summary: A bad accident occurred in the English Channel involving an oil tanker and a cargo ship. The accident happened in the morning and the weather conditions were very stormy at the time.

questions.question:
Metindeki 1. cümleyi doğru kelimeyle tamamlayın:
A bad accident occurred in the English Channel ____ an oil tanker and a cargo ship.

Metindeki 2. cümleyi doğru kelimeyle tamamlayın:
The accident happened in the morning and the weather ____ were very stormy at the time.
